public.text: The list of catalogue attributes includes adverse-event linkage and drug interactions. These may belong to pharmacovigilance, clinical knowledge, regulatory, or decision-support systems rather than one catalogue tool.
public.suggestedRevision: Refine the catalogue scope and identify authoritative sources for each enriched attribute rather than implying one tool originates all information.
